description: This file defines the AuthenticationService class which handles user authentication logic within the OrangeHRM system. It manages user credential validation, setting user attributes, and handling exceptions related to user status and termination.

classes.name: AuthenticationService
classes.description: Service class responsible for user authentication processes, including credential validation, user attribute setting, and exception handling based on user status.

methods.name: setCredentialsForUser
methods.description: Validates user object and sets user attributes if the user is active and not terminated.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Fetches user credentials and attempts to set user attributes using the provided credentials.

methods.name: setUserAttributes
methods.description: Assigns user-related data to the authenticated user context, such as user ID, role, and modification date.
